basic_profile.bio: Aspiring filmmaker and VR enthusiast from Austin, Texas. Recently stumbled upon Reddit while researching unique storytelling perspectives and have been exploring various communities since. Passionate about independent films and cutting-edge technology, especially how VR can be integrated into film production. Not a fan of overly commercialized cinema. Usually online during late evenings after my day job as a barista. In a relationship with someone who shares my love for avant-garde cinema.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained most of my knowledge in film production through a mix of formal education in a local community college and hands-on experience from working on small indie film sets. Recently diving into VR tech through self-study and online courses.
